'''''Aloe affinis''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Asphodelaceae]] family.<ref name=KewPOWO>{{cite web|url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:529175-1|title= Aloe affinis A.Berger|author=<!--Not stated-->|date=n.d.|website=Plants of the World Online|publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|access-date= August 21, 2020}}</ref> It is endemic to [[Limpopo]], [[Gauteng]], and [[Mpumalanga]], of [[South Africa]]. It grows {{Convert abbreviated|200-300|mm}} tall excluding inflorescence, with 16–20 leaves per plant, each leaf being roughly 200 mm long x 50–100 mm wide.
